name: Epic Shatterbow

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus : +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Improved Destruction
effects.tooltip: Improved Destruction : On Hit: Your target gains a stack of Armor Destruction. (-1 penalty to Armor Class , -1% of its Fortification . 20 Second Duration. Stacks up to 15 times.) This effect may trigger once every second.

effects.name: Sonic Blast
effects.tooltip: Sonic Blast 4 : This weapon rings with the power of sound, dealing 4d6 Sonic damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Sonic damage on a critical hit.

effects.name: Construct Bane
effects.tooltip: Construct Bane 4 : This weapon is attuned specifically to disrupt creations, dealing an additional 4d10 bane damage vs. Constructs.

effects.name: Armor-Piercing
effects.tooltip: Armor-Piercing 15% : Passive: +15% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)

effects.name: Adamantine
effects.tooltip: Adamantine : Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.

effects.name: Move Silently
effects.tooltip: Move Silently -10 : Passive: -10 penalty to the Move Silently skill.

flavor_text: Arrows fired from this bow are invested with powerful sonic energy, and are shot so fast that they shriek through the air. Constructs hit by these arrows are wounded grievously.
